windows.text: Card games and social gatherings don’t tell you everything, but asking someone out of the blue, (through) “Okay, so what lessons did you find for yourself?”

windows.label: Human
windows.text: Look at the most recent conflicts and ask if you were able to regulate yourself during them.

windows.label: Human
windows.text: What did you do to the other person, and how did you repair the damage afterward?

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: Has your judgment gotten better, or would your friends or exes say you keep falling for the same stuff?

windows.label: AI-Generated
windows.text: And if you tell me you shut down, I’d ask whether that meant you stopped talking to your partner for days, and whether they felt abandoned.
